checks.name: the dashboard logs in at the hub
the browser also holds a session at the peer (as after one login there)
two Chrome windows: LEFT and RIGHT (the dashboard) are different OS windows
the Status tab lists the three agents (two local, one on the remote peer)
1a first click with no host: the toast says "one-time setup" (host-created)
1b the host tab was opened, beside the dashboard (RIGHT)
1c the agent did NOT open in the dashboard window
1d host in the LEFT window: agent A opens there
1e the stand-in host beside the dashboard handed over and closed itself
2a agent B (local) opens in LEFT, as its active tab
2b agent C (REMOTE peer harness, another origin) opens in LEFT, as its active tab
2c the dashboard window holds no agent tab
3a re-click: A handled in LEFT — left-focused (raised) or left-steered (Chrome forbade the raise); the raise itself is proven from chrome.tabs in the drag run
3b …without a reload (in-page state kept)
3c …and no duplicate tab (LEFT still holds host + 3 agents)
4a after a dashboard REFRESH: re-click B handled in LEFT (focused or steered), no new tab
4b a dashboard opened in a fresh tab is in the RIGHT window
4c from the fresh dashboard tab (no opener, no names): A is handled in LEFT, no reload
4d no agent tab ever landed in RIGHT
5a LEFT window closed, click: "host-created" (one-time setup again)
5b nothing opened in the dashboard window but the host
5c new LEFT window with the host: the queued agent B opens there
5d and A too
5e after the HOST tab reloads: re-click B is handled in LEFT, no duplicate
6a Chrome reopened on the same profile (pop-up allowance and placement kept; the session was not restored)
6b first click after the restart: "host-created" — the one-time step again, nothing opened in RIGHT
6c host placed in LEFT again: the remote agent C opens there
6d and every later click lands there too
no page errors on the dashboard

frames.caption: start: LEFT is an empty window, RIGHT is the dashboard
1. first click, no host yet: a host tab opens beside the dashboard and asks to be dragged left; the agent waits in it
1. host placed in LEFT: it opens agent A (phone-agent) there; the stand-in closed itself
2. B (local game-arcade) and C (REMOTE peer msg-platform-agent) open in LEFT too
3. re-click A: handled in LEFT without a reload or a duplicate (raised where Chrome allows - proven from chrome.tabs in the drag run)
4. dashboard refreshed (F5): B still handled in LEFT
4. dashboard in a brand-new tab (no opener, no window names): A still handled in LEFT
5. LEFT window closed: the click opens a host beside the dashboard, no agent in RIGHT
5. a new LEFT window with the host: B and A open there
6. Chrome reopened (nothing restored): the host placed once, then every click lands in LEFT again
